q: What is the cut-off time for getting same-day NAV in Kaveri's mutual-fund schemes?
reference: 3:00 pm on business days; for purchases the funds must also be realised in the scheme's account before 3:00 pm.

A.answer: The cut-off time for same-day NAV in Kaveri's mutual-fund schemes is **3:00 pm on business days** for both equity and debt schemes [1][2]. For purchases, the funds must also be realised in the scheme's bank account before 3:00 pm; otherwise the next business day's NAV applies [1][2].

cited.title: NAV Computation and Cut-off Timings
cited.text:
## 1. Quick answer: which NAV applies?

For all Kaveri mutual-fund-style schemes (Bluechip, Flexi Cap, Small Cap Opportunities, Short Duration, Arbitrage):

| Transaction | Received by Kaveri before 3:00 pm | Received at or after 3:00 pm |
|---|---|---|
| Purchase / SIP / switch-in | Same day's NAV, **if funds are realised** in the scheme's bank account before 3:00 pm | Next business day's NAV (subject to funds realised) |
| Redemption / switch-out | Same day's NAV | Next business day's NAV |

- **Cut-off time is 3:00 pm** on business days, for both equity and debt schemes.
- For purchases, what matters is when the **money reaches the scheme's account**, not when the investor clicked "invest". A purchase submitted at 11:00 am but with funds credited at 3:20 pm gets the next business day's NAV.
- The time stamp is the one recorded by the registrar's system or the Kaveri website/app server, not the investor's phone clock.
- A "business day" excludes Saturdays, Sundays and stock-exchange or bank holidays in Mumbai.

cited.title: Investor Service FAQ – Redemptions, Exit Loads and Statements
cited.text:
## 1. Buying and redeeming

**What is the cut-off time for same-day NAV?**
3:00 pm on business days, for both equity and debt schemes. Redemptions received before 3:00 pm get that day's NAV. For purchases, the money must also be credited to the scheme's bank account before 3:00 pm; otherwise the next business day's NAV applies.

**I placed a redemption on Saturday. Which NAV will I get?**
The next business day's NAV (normally Monday's).

**How long does a redemption take to reach my bank account?**
Within 3 working days of the redemption date for all schemes. For the Arbitrage and Short Duration funds we usually pay within 2 working days. If we are late beyond the regulatory timeline, we pay interest at 15% per annum for each day of delay.

**Where is my redemption money paid?**
Only to the bank account registered in your folio. We never pay redemption proceeds to a third-party account.

**Can I pay or invest in cash?**
No. Kaveri does not accept cash for any investment, in any amount. Please pay by cheque, NEFT, RTGS, UPI or mandate from a bank account in your own name.

A.answer: The dissolution acceptance criterion for Glucosan-M 500 SR tablets requires: 20–40% released at 1 hour, 45–65% at 3 hours, and **not less than 80% (Q) released at 10 hours**, which is the critical release criterion. |--------------|-----------------------|

| 3 hours      | 45-65%                |
| 10 hours     | Not less than 80% (Q) |

q: What is the exit load on the Kaveri Arbitrage Fund?
reference: 0.25% if redeemed within 15 days of allotment; nil thereafter.

A.answer: The Kaveri Arbitrage Fund charges an exit load of **0.25% if redeemed within 15 days of allotment**; there is no exit load after that period [1][2][3].

cited.title: Investor Service FAQ – Redemptions, Exit Loads and Statements
cited.text:
## 2. Exit loads

**What exit load applies to the equity funds?**

| Scheme | Exit load |
|---|---|
| Kaveri Bluechip Fund | 1% if redeemed within 365 days of allotment |
| Kaveri Flexi Cap Fund | 1% if redeemed within 365 days of allotment |
| Kaveri Small Cap Opportunities | 1% if redeemed within 365 days of allotment |
| Kaveri Short Duration Fund | Nil |
| Kaveri Arbitrage Fund | 0.25% if redeemed within 15 days of allotment |

**Is there an exit load if I redeem my Flexi Cap units after 8 months?**
Yes. Eight months is within 365 days of allotment, so an exit load of 1% applies to those units. Units held for more than 365 days carry no exit load.

**How is the exit load worked out if I invested through a SIP?**
Each SIP instalment is treated separately on a first-in, first-out basis. When you redeem, the oldest units are redeemed first, and only units still within 365 days of their own allotment date carry the 1% load.

**Does a switch between Kaveri funds attract exit load?**
Yes. A switch is treated as a redemption from the first scheme for exit load purposes.

**Are dividend reinvestment units charged exit load?**
No.

**What is the exit load on the PMS?**

| Withdrawal within (from date of each contribution) | Exit load |
|---|---|
| Year 1 | 3% |
| Year 2 | 2% |
| Year 3 | 1% |
| After 3 years | Nil |

**And on the AIF?**
The Kaveri Long-Short AIF III has a 12-month lock-in from each contribution. After the lock-in, an exit load of 1% applies in months 13–24 and nil after that. Redemptions are monthly with 30 days' notice.

q: What is the finger-dab acceptance limit for Grade C gowning qualification?
reference: Finger dab ≤ 5 CFU per glove, and gown contact plates ≤ 5 CFU per plate.

A.answer: The finger‑dab acceptance limit for Grade C gowning qualification is **≤ 5 CFU per glove** [1].

cited.title: SOP – Cleanroom Gowning
cited.text:
## 5.6 Gowning qualification

1. New employees complete classroom training and 3 consecutive successful gowning demonstrations before first entry to Grade C.
2. Contact plates (RODAC, 55 mm) are taken from 5 locations: both gloved hands (finger dab), forearms, chest and hood.
3. Acceptance for Grade C qualification: finger dab ≤ 5 CFU/glove; gown contact plates ≤ 5 CFU/plate.
4. Requalification is annual. A person who fails twice is retrained and may not enter Grade C until requalified.

4. Requalification is annual. A person who fails twice is retrained and may not enter Grade C until requalified.

## 5. Limitation of liability

- Liability cap: each party's total liability under the MSA in any contract year is limited to the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim.

| Requirement       | Value                                                                                                                        |

cited.text:
## 3.3 Administrative and privileged accounts

- Minimum length of 20 characters, generated by the password manager.
- Separate admin accounts (prefix adm-) are used for privileged work; normal accounts are never given admin rights.
- Privileged access to production (including NimbusOps on AWS) is granted just-in-time for a maximum of 8 hours through the privileged access management tool, with ticket reference.

B.answer: The minimum password length for regular user accounts at Nimbus is **14 characters** [1][2]. For administrative and privileged accounts, a longer minimum of 20 characters applies [3].

cited.title: Welcome to Nimbus
cited.text:
### 6.1 Day 1

1. Report to the reception of your base office at 9:30 am with your original ID and education documents.
2. Collect your laptop from the IT desk. It arrives encrypted (BitLocker on Windows, FileVault on macOS) and enrolled in device management.
3. Set your password (minimum 14 characters) and register MFA on the Nimbus Authenticator app. You cannot access email, Slack or the HRMS without MFA.
4. Attend the 2-hour induction session run by People Operations at 11:00 am.

cited.title: NimbusOps Database Failover Runbook
cited.text:
## 1. Scope

This runbook covers failover of the NimbusOps primary metadata database: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 16, cluster `nops-prod-pg01`, running Multi-AZ in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai) with a cross-region read replica `nops-dr-pg01` in ap-south-2 (Hyderabad). It does not cover the time-series store or Kafka (see NIM/ENG/RB-002).

NimbusOps commitments that drive this runbook:

| Objective | Target |
|---|---|
| Monthly availability SLO | 99.9% |
| Recovery Point Objective (RPO) | 15 min |
| Recovery Time Objective (RTO) | 1 h |
| Error budget per 30-day month | 43 min 12 s |

B.answer: The monthly error budget is **43 minutes 12 seconds** [1]

q: What is the night-shift allowance for plant employees?
reference: ₹2,800 per month for employees working at least 10 night shifts in the month; otherwise ₹280 per night shift pro-rata.

A.answer: The night-shift allowance for plant employees is **₹2,800 per month** if they work at least 10 night shifts in the month; for fewer than 10 night shifts it is paid pro-rata at **₹280 per night shift** [1]. This rate was last updated to ₹2,800 effective 1 April 2026 [2].

cited.text:
## 5. Shift allowance





| Shift         | Allowance        |
|---------------|------------------|
| A (Morning)   | Nil              |
| B (Afternoon) | ₹1,200 per month |
| C (Night)     | ₹2,800 per month |

5.1 The night-shift allowance of ₹2,800 per month is paid to plant employees who work at least 10 night shifts in the month; below 10 night shifts it is paid pro-rata at ₹280 per night shift. 5.2 Night-shift employees receive a free meal and company transport from fixed pick-up points. 5.3 Shift allowance is not part of basic salary and does not count for PF, gratuity or leave encashment.
